paragraphs: Bava Batra 29a: Abaye said to Rav Nachman, “If so, those of the household of Bar Elyashiv, who object even to one who passes over their boundary,” etc. In Ketubot 54a, a daughter-in-law of the household of Bar Elyashiv was claiming her ketubah from orphans; they came before Ravina, etc.
